text:
Adrian M.: Heads up — ACME reported their SIEM mapping is dropping tenant context for webhook deliveries this morning.
Lina C.: Ugh, that sounds like the tenant_id field might be getting renamed during the transformation step. Which delivery path?
Adrian M.: Webhooks to their Splunk HEC. They said the events show account.name but not our tenant_id header.
Samir: @Adrian M. can you paste a sample payload (sanitized) and headers?
Adrian M.: Sure — sent privately, but here's the sanitized body we confirmed:
```json
{
  "event": "model.request",
  "request_id": "req_12345",
  "actor": {"id": "user_abc", "role": "engineer"},
  "resource": {"model": "redwood/gpt-test"},
  "meta": {"tenant": "acme-corp", "region": "us-west-2"},
  "timestamp": "2026-03-03T14:12:01Z"
}
```
Lina C.: Hmm we normally include tenant_id at top-level audit. Looks like their ingest pipeline expects `tenant_id` and we changed to `meta.tenant` in schema v2.
Security Bot: NOTICE: Audit schema v2 deployed to staging 2026-03-02 03:45 UTC.
Samir: Ok this is the classic schema drift. Two things — (1) we should provide a compatibility shim for webhook deliveries (map `meta.tenant` -> `tenant_id`), (2) update our onboarding docs + sample payload for Splunk/Datadog.
Infra Eng: We can add a transform layer in the webhook delivery service. Low risk — config flag per customer.
Adrian M.: Config flag is fine. But also customer interested in KMS envelope headers — they saw the webhook HMAC header change after key rotation and thought it was a breaking change.
Lina C.: That's on us to document KMS rotation semantics: envelope key rotates, signature uses signing key id in `X-RW-Signature-Key` header. We should include an example: `X-RW-Signature-Key: rsa-kid-2026-02`
Samir: Also we should ensure our webhook retry headers are present for SIEM correlation: `X-RW-Retry-Count`, `X-RW-Original-Ts`. Customers often rely on those for de-duplication.
Customer Success - Priya: ACME is asking for an example Splunk HEC ingestion mapping and the expected field names so their SIEM team can write searches.
Lina C.: I'll draft a short mapping:
- `tenant_id` (string) top-level
- `event` (string) top-level
- `timestamp` (iso8601) top-level
- `request_id` top-level
- `actor.id` -> `user.id` (flattened)
- `resource.model` -> `model.name`
Samir: And for Datadog / generic SIEM we provide both flattened and nested variants. Offer example Grok/Transform for their ingestion:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "event": "model.request",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-03T14:12:01Z",
  "request_id": "req_12345",
  "user.id": "user_abc",
  "model.name": "redwood/gpt-test"
}
```
Adrian M.: Action items?
Lina C.: 1) Infra: implement webhook transform shim and enable per-customer compatibility (owner: Infra Eng).
Lina C.: 2) Docs: update Splunk/Datadog onboarding examples and call out `meta.tenant` vs `tenant_id` (owner: Lina).
Lina C.: 3) Security: add note on KMS envelope rotation and header semantics to onboarding checklist (owner: Samir).
Samir: I'll add a small test to our integration suite that asserts `tenant_id` present in delivered payload when compatibility flag is on.
Infra Eng: ETA for shim: 2 days if no surprises. Will deploy to staging behind feature-flag.
Customer Success - Priya: Please loop me in on the docs so I can send ACME the updated ingestion mapping.
Adrian M.: One more thing — we should also clarify pseudonymization options for PII in audit logs (customer asked about `user.email`). We have PII masking in exports; we need to document tradeoffs for SIEM correlation vs privacy.
Lina C.: Agreed. I'll add a short section: masking options (hash, redact), and recommend `hash(user.email)` plus `user.id` for correlation.
Security Bot: TASK CREATED: SEC-1792 add webhook shim, update docs, add KMS rotation note.
Samir: Will follow up on PRs.
Adrian M.: Thanks all. I'll update ACME once infra confirms staging test pass. :thumbsup:
